description: This file declares common constants, template classes, and base classes related to Metal renderer in ANGLE project, including device context, error handling, and Objective-C object management.

classes.name: WrappedObject
classes.description: Template class managing Objective-C object lifetime.

classes.name: AutoObjCPtr
classes.description: Template class allowing ownership transfer of Objective-C objects.

classes.name: ErrorHandler
classes.description: Interface for error handling in Metal context.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Represents Metal rendering context, manages device and command queue.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles errors with error code or NSError object.

methods.name: getMetalDevice
methods.description: Returns the Metal device associated with the context.

methods.name: cmdQueue
methods.description: Returns the command queue for rendering commands.
